invariants.rationale: The method immediately calls methods on clusteringPlan, so it must not be null.
The schema is passed to downstream clustering functions and likely must not be null.
instantTime is used to uniquely identify the clustering commit, so it should not be null.
An empty instantTime may not be a valid clustering instant.
The method iterates over clusteringPlan.getInputGroups(), so it must not be null.
